# duploai_admin_quota_definition (Resource)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk quota definition — a spend/token limit (with a buffer) applied over a daily or monthly period, which quota mappings then bind to platform or workspace scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Daily USD quota.
resource "duploai_admin_quota_definition" "daily" {
  name      = "daily-spend"
  type      = "Daily"
  limit_usd = 50
}

# Monthly USD quota.
resource "duploai_admin_quota_definition" "monthly" {
  name        = "monthly-budget"
  type        = "Monthly"
  limit_usd   = 2000
  description = "Monthly org budget"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limit_usd` (Number) Spend limit in USD for the period. Must be at least 0.01.
- `name` (String) Name of the quota definition.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the quota definition.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the quota definition is active. Defaults to active when omitted.
- `type` (String) Period the quota applies over. Defaults to 'Daily'.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the quota definition was created (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of the user who created the quota definition.
- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier (workspace_id/id).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the quota definition was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `updated_by` (String) Identifier of the user who last updated the quota definition.
- `version` (Number) Version counter, incremented on each update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing quota definition.
#  - QUOTA_ID is the unique identifier of the quota definition (e.g. 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e)
terraform import duploai_admin_quota_definition.myquota QUOTA_ID
# Example:
# terraform import duploai_admin_quota_definition.myquota 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e
```
